description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a large light-pink pillow is in front, with a white charging cable lying on the bed and a smartphone nearby. The right hand reaches forward to pick up the phone and turns it so the screen faces up, while the left hand lifts the charging cable end and guides it into the phone’s charging port, making the charging cable a two-hand object during the connection; then the right hand lowers the phone back onto the bed and releases it while the cable stays attached.
